$comment: Pinned expansions: for each binding in curated/shapes/bindings.json, the semantics.formal block that expand() must produce, byte for byte. A test fixture, deliberately NOT regenerated -- that is the whole point. Each value here was verified by a human once; if expand.py or a shape template changes, workflow/formal/test_shapes.py fails against these rather than silently producing a different corpus. Recomputing them would make the test compare expand() to expand() and check nothing. Keyed 'ppm:function', joined against bindings.json.
